data.evidence_sentence: The David Sainsbury Full MSc Scholarship is available to applicants from least-developed, low-income, and lower-middle-income countries or territories according to the Overseas Development Assistance Committee (DAC) list.
data.notes: Page is a third-party listing (Global South Opportunities) and states it is not the organising body; verify on the official site. No application deadline is stated. Page says all full scholarships for the 2026 intake are already allocated, so only the 50% tuition awards remain. The text also says the award is available to candidates from higher-income and upper-middle-income countries, including the UK, which conflicts with the DAC-country rule for the full scholarship; the nationality rule reflects the full scholarship. Maintenance grant and up to £4,000 travel are stated for the full award. Selection is automatic during MSc admission, with no separate application.
